releaseStatus.note: Available through the normal public updater feed for supported macOS and Windows installations. Configured official builds show a first-run anonymous-reporting notice and keep the opt-out in Settings; see Privacy.

entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV desktop Rive animation viewer. The public 2.4.4 release isolates playback in a dedicated WebView, uses reactive and bounded UI synchronization, provides anonymous version reporting with a first-run notice and Settings opt-out, and retains safe runtime 2.39.2 by default, applied-editor-aware standalone export, document icons, and event inspection.
